content:
Youth Face Body Lotion is a refined everyday body-care essential created for a simple, comfortable moisturising routine. In a convenient 40 ml format, this lightweight lotion helps keep body skin feeling hydrated, soft and refreshed without a heavy finish.

Its quick-absorbing, non-greasy texture fits easily into your daily routine—whether used after bathing, before heading out, or whenever skin needs a moment of moisturising care. Youth Face Body Lotion is a separate body-care product and is not positioned as a substitute for Youth Face Beauty Cream.

Why Choose Youth Face Body Lotion

  • Lightweight body moisturising: Designed to support a comfortable, hydrated-feeling finish for everyday body skin.
  • Quick-absorbing texture: Massages in easily for a streamlined body-care routine.
  • Non-greasy feel: Made for moisturising without a heavy or sticky-feeling finish.
  • Comfortable for daily use: A practical choice for regular body moisturising.
  • Convenient 40 ml size: A compact format that is easy to keep close at hand.

How to Use

Apply a generous amount to clean, dry body skin. Massage gently until absorbed. Use daily or whenever your skin needs moisturising.

Suitable For

Suitable for all skin types subject to final product-label confirmation.
